coverage_decision: All main-text figures/tables and all supplied supplements were inspected and reconciled. Bibliographic references were extracted separately to Markdown rather than atomized.

omissions.item: Individual active-vs-active cells across S3–S14 matrices
omissions.reason: Reconciled for source-wide SEA interpretation but not atomized cell-by-cell; those estimates are secondary-source results and would generate hundreds of low-reuse atoms. Central and vs-placebo estimates are preserved.
